thesis: 截至2026-10-10 09:15 SGT，美股10月9日反弹与居民信心下降、能源通胀并存：S&P 500涨0.59%至7,811.54，但密歇根大学10月消费者信心初值降至46.3，未来一年通胀预期升至4.7%；Brent在美国墨西哥湾飓风停产与霍尔木兹风险下收于104.72美元。美债10年期约5.24%的高折现率仍约束高资本开支资产，10月12日美股开市而美债休市，需分阶段验证反弹广度及周二长端收益率。
dominant_narrative: 本期为2026年10月10日周六北京时间的唯一Morning Official，采用10月9日16:00 EDT周五美国现金股票收盘，没有虚构周六美国行情。已核实S&P 500 7,811.54（+0.59%）、Nasdaq 27,366.17（+0.64%），但Russell 2000整周仍跌0.9%。密歇根大学10月消费者信心46.3低于9月48.1，同时1年通胀预期4.7%、5年3.5%，构成“增长↓、物价预期↑”矛盾。油价先因美伊外交表态回落，又在飓风导致美国墨西哥湾离岸生产大面积关闭时回升，December Brent收于104.72美元。Delta最新季报调整后收入176亿美元、调整后EPS 1.72美元，但将FY调整后EPS指引从6.50–7.50美元降至5.10–5.60美元，明确展示能源成本向利润转换的压力。加拿大9月就业-68,300人、欧中混动汽车贸易初步理解、SpaceX约80亿美元频谱协议分别带来增长、政策与电信竞争差异化冲击。周一美股与美国债券现金市场交易日错位，应先观察现货股票广度和原油实物供应，待债市恢复后再确认折现率是否缓解。

top_catalysts.event: Oct 9 oil settlement $104.72: Gulf hurricane shut-ins withstand Iran diplomacy relief
top_catalysts.what_happened: Brent December ended at $104.72 (+0.42%) and WTI November at $91.85 (+0.39%) on Oct9 after early declines; Gulf offshore crude production shutdowns surpassed 70% as Hurricane Isaias approached.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The final settlements reversed early diplomacy-led oil declines and leave Hormuz transit and offshore production constraints unverified as restored.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Higher oil and fuel premiums directly erode household real income and airline margins while feeding inflation expectations and longer-duration discount rates.
top_catalysts.transmission: Physical Gulf outage and shipping → oil/refined fuel premiums → household inflation expectations → bond yields → risk equity multiples.
top_catalysts.confirmation: Verified restoration in U.S. Gulf offshore production and shipping with sustained lower Brent and Treasury yields confirms real easing.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Fresh audited Gulf outage extension, verified shipping attacks or oil-price reacceleration rejects near-term supply normalization.

top_catalysts.event: Oct 9 Michigan confidence 46.3 with one-year inflation expectations 4.7%
top_catalysts.what_happened: The University of Michigan October preliminary sentiment index fell to 46.3 from September 48.1; current conditions were 44.7 while one-year inflation expectations rose to 4.7% and five-year to 3.5%.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The earlier pending survey became an actual data release showing weaker household confidence alongside rising expected inflation at both horizons.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Growth concerns cannot be read as automatically dovish when anticipated prices remain sticky, so US yields and rate-sensitive equities face offsetting forces.
top_catalysts.transmission: Energy/real income stress → worse sentiment plus higher expected CPI → uncertainty in Fed reaction → rates and credit/tech multiples.
top_catalysts.confirmation: Follow-up inflation/consumption prints and matched US Treasury yields can show whether weaker demand outweighs price expectations.
top_catalysts.invalidation: New surveys contradict rising inflation expectations and reveal clear disinflation despite energy pressure.

top_catalysts.event: Oct 9 Delta cuts adjusted FY2026 EPS guidance to $5.10–$5.60 despite growing revenue
top_catalysts.what_happened: Delta reported September-quarter GAAP revenue $20.2bn, adjusted revenue $17.6bn and adjusted EPS $1.72; FY adjusted EPS was cut to $5.10–$5.60 versus prior $6.50–$7.50 in the high fuel-cost environment.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The airline's new primary results quantify the margin difference between nominal revenue expansion and significantly weaker earnings outlook.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: The roughly $6bn increased annual fuel burden highlights tangible commodity inflation transmission to corporate cash generation and carrier credit quality.
top_catalysts.transmission: Jet fuel↑ → airline adjusted margins and free cash flow↓ → EPS revisions↓ → cyclical consumer and credit risk premium↑.
top_catalysts.confirmation: Documented jet fuel retreat together with improved airline cash flow and maintained travel yields confirms recovery.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Another issuer profit downgrade, higher fuel, or worsening quarterly cash conversion invalidates margin resilience.
